name: Pricasso
source:
A painter who lives on the street living the life he always wished. He knows that people don’t care about art, but he hopes to become someone important one day. For now, he tries to survive living of art and working part-time in a hard-discount. He has a big interest in Bali since the beginning, attracted by his eccentric style a nice body proportions (to cut it short, he’s madly in love with him!) . Sometimes he should think double before talking…
He spends most of his money buying supplies and grass. Smocking helps him being the same carefree guy as usual.
